A scene at the River Jordan. John the Baptist, wearing a rough camel-hair garment, is pouring water over Jesus, who is standing waist-deep in the river. Above them, the clouds part to reveal a bright light, and a white dove is descending directly toward Jesus. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A three-panel illustration showing the three temptations of Jesus. Left panel: Jesus in a rocky, barren wilderness, looking calmly at a cloaked figure pointing at stones on the ground. Middle panel: Jesus standing on the high, ornate roof (pinnacle) of the Jerusalem temple, with the tempter gesturing downward. Right panel: Jesus standing on a high mountain peak, with the tempter pointing outwards to grand, glowing cities in the distance. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
